title: Agent delegation policy (v1)
description: JSON Schema 2020-12 for the delegation policy document referenced by ENS text records `delegation` (URI) and `policy-hash` (keccak256 of canonical bytes) on emilemarcelagustin.eth. Declares the authorized delegators, scope of session-key authority, binding to the active session key, and revocation procedure. Versioning lives in $id; key names never carry version suffixes.

$id.description: Canonical HTTPS URL of this policy instance. MUST end in .../policies/delegation-policy-vN.json. Bump N on every policy change.

schema-uri.description: URI of the schema document validating this instance. SHOULD be ipfs:// for content-addressed integrity.

agent-id.description: ERC-8004 Identity Registry token id on the chain identified by chain-id.

kernel-wallet.description: Smart-account kernel that the session key acts on behalf of. Stable across rotations.

version.description: Human-readable version (v1, v1.1, v2). MUST match the suffix in $id.

issued-at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when this policy version was authored.

ens.description: ENS name that resolves to address, if any.

role.description: primary = on-chain owner of the ENS name; co-authority = additional authorized signer per this policy.

threshold.description: Signature threshold over the delegators array. e.g. '1-of-2'.

scope.description: Cryptographic actions the active session key is authorized to perform.

ttl-hours.description: Maximum lifetime (in hours) of any session key issued under this policy.

permitted-message-classes.description: Semantic classes of messages the session key may sign. Free-form strings; verifiers SHOULD reject signatures over messages outside these classes.

prohibited.description: Explicitly forbidden actions. Verifiers MUST reject any signed payload that performs these. Common entries: 'userop-broadcast', 'value-transfer', 'contract-write'.

address.description: Currently authorized session signer. MUST equal the runtime-pubkey ENS text record while this policy is in force.

mechanism.description: v1 supports only this mechanism. Future versions MAY add reputation-list or on-chain registry hooks.

procedure.description: Ordered prose steps the owner follows to revoke + rotate.

verification.description: How a third party verifies a signature against the live policy. e.g. 'Fetch ipfs://<CID> via the `delegation` ENS record; assert keccak256 of canonical bytes equals `policy-hash`; confirm signer matches `runtime-pubkey`.'
